prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Transform the attached vessel image into one reusable wall bay for the same steampunk engine works. Preserve its exact art language: compact detailed painted pixel art, rounded dark green enamel iron, antique golden brass flanges, warm upper-left highlights, cool shaded recesses. Replace the crystal vessel and its silhouette completely with an industrial INTERIOR BACK WALL module, front elevation from a slightly elevated orthographic camera with horizontal edges. Squat warm gray stone block masonry, one broad arched ribbed green-iron factory window with smoky pale blue glass, thick riveted green iron support columns at both outer edges, two substantial brass feed pipes and a low green steel base. Restrained functional construction rather than ornament. Width:height about 4:3; will export at 192x144 native pixels. Complete rectangular silhouette on genuine transparency, bottom edge level so repeated bays form one continuous wall. Shallow visible depth, convincing rounded pipes and raised fasteners, broad quiet masonry areas rather than noise. No marble, gilded palace ornament, Gothic tracery, decorative columns, crystal, shrine, deity, floor in front, ground island, people, labels, letters, fog or particles.

Use case: style-transfer. Transform the reference vessel's detailed painted pixel material language into a seamless opaque square industrial masonry FLOOR texture. This is a top-down orthographic surface, not a room or object. Medium-value warm gray quarry-stone blocks in staggered rows, broad worn matte surfaces, fine dark joints, very restrained small surface nicks. Each large block is about 48x48 or 96x48 at the final 192x192 native-pixel export. The floor belongs beneath the reference's antique brass and deep green enamel machinery. Keep the reference's crisp dimensional painted pixel detailing and warm upper-left light, but make this floor quiet enough for dark-clothed 60px characters to remain readable. Edge-to-edge seamless repeat in both axes, no border, perspective, vignette, bright highlights, debris, stains or added objects. No checkerboard, marble veins, decorative brass corner inlays, crystal, polished ballroom floor, grass, figures, lettering or gear emblems. Gray stone is the dominant material, with moderate contrast, neither white nor near-black.

Use case: style-transfer. Transform the reference vessel's green enamel and brass surfaces into one seamless opaque square industrial STEEL FLOOR texture for its servicing platforms. Exactly top-down orthographic, no room perspective. Large rectangular muted green-gray steel plates with dark shallow recessed seams and sparing antique brass bolts at their edges; enamel rubbed pale on the broad matte centers. Same rounded worn painted pixel material language and restrained warm highlights as the vessel. 192x192 native-pixel export; four plate widths across, each plate about 48px with broad calm centers. Functional load-bearing deck, not ornamental floor. Subtle relief at joints with consistent upper-left highlights. Seamless repeat in both axes and no outer border. No checkerboard, marble, decorative gold patterns, engravings, dense perforated noise, repeated gear emblems, full-surface rivet dots, dirt piles, objects, people, text, perspective, vignette or cast shadows from unseen props. Medium brightness so character boots and outlines remain readable.

Use case: style-transfer. Replace the reference vessel with one short reusable staircase made from its same dark green enamel iron and warm antique brass. Preserve the detailed dimensional painted pixel style and upper-left light. Front orthographic view from slightly above, horizontal treads; one centered 144x96 native-pixel staircase module with four broad gray-green iron treads, restrained brass nosing, thick side stringers and a small top landing. The stair runs from bottom center toward top center, with complete visible side edges and shallow cast shadows only within its own footprint. Industrial steel, gently worn, broad recognizable surfaces with sparse fasteners, no microscopic noise. Transparent background, no room, surrounding floor island, pipe machinery, crystal, handrails, pillars, people, text, checker background, extra disconnected parts, palace ornament, marble, moss or cobblestones. Native width:height 3:2. The playable character will walk directly on the treads.

Use case: style-transfer. Replace the vessel with a small modular pipe-fitting asset sheet retaining exactly its dark green rounded enamel pipe barrels, antique brass flange joints, warm upper-left light, crisp detailed painted pixel style. Transparent background. STRICT arrangement: two columns by four rows of equal square cells, with one pipe fitting centered in each cell. Row 1: straight horizontal pipe, straight vertical pipe. Row 2: 90-degree elbow joining north and east, 90-degree elbow joining north and west. Row 3: 90-degree elbow joining south and east, 90-degree elbow joining south and west. Row 4: T joining west/east/south, cross joining north/east/south/west. Each pipe connects at the exact MIDPOINT of its cell edge, and continues all the way to that cell edge with a flat crop, no end caps. Every connection is the same diameter, about one-third of cell width. Broad rounded barrels, restrained brass bands, dark seams and small bolts. Keep tiny gaps between unrelated cells without moving the connection centerlines; no labels or drawn grid. Will be exported as eight 24x24 native tiles, so prioritize simple volumes and readable specular edges. No machinery, floor, white background, perspective slant, crystal, lettering, gears, steam, ornament or floating fragments.
